_protocol.aim: Retire the [ASSUMED] markers on _WRONG_SERVER_PHRASES / _AUTH_PHRASES in analytics-service/services/mt5_validation.py by recording MEASURED MT5 login-rejection strings. No authoritative MT5 error-text table exists, so a phrase invented from memory is a fabrication and a measured pair is the only evidence that retires a marker.
_protocol.shape: This file is a JSON array. The FIRST element is this header (JSON carries no comments). Every OTHER element is one observation: {"account": <synthetic label>, "code": <int>, "text": <rejection text>, "expected": "auth" | "wrong_server" | "transient"}.
_protocol.consumed_by: analytics-service/tests/test_mt5_validate.py — test_each_measured_login_rejection_classifies_as_recorded parametrizes over the observations, and test_the_live_spike_fixture_exists_and_carries_its_capture_protocol asserts this header UNCONDITIONALLY so an empty array cannot make the gate vanish.
_protocol.founder_enters_credentials_no_agent_ever: The live spike is FOUNDER-ONLY. No agent drives it and no agent enters, reads, decrypts, logs or echoes a credential at any point.
_protocol.capture_code_and_text_from_login_rejecti: Capture the (code, text) pair from a login REJECTION and nothing else. Not a session transcript, not a terminal dump, not a log excerpt.
_protocol.never_an_account_identifier: A real MT5 account number is NEVER written here, in any field, in any form.
_protocol.never_a_broker_server_name: A real broker server name is NEVER written here. If the rejection text itself contains one, replace it with a synthetic placeholder before writing the entry.
_protocol.never_a_password: A password is NEVER written here, and never appears in a captured text field.
_protocol.accounts_are_synthetic_labels_substitute: The "account" field is a synthetic label ("acct-a", "acct-b") chosen by the founder and substituted BEFORE anything is written. It identifies which capture session a pair came from, never which account.
_protocol.partial_sets_land_each_pair_retires_one_: Partial sets LAND. One measured pair is worth appending on its own; there is no all-or-nothing gate and no minimum count.
_protocol.nothing_in_this_phase_blocks_on_it: The refusal rule shipped WITHOUT the spike and is independently correct. This table is an additive follow-up and blocks nothing.
_protocol.why_this_file_is_safe_to_commit: The repo is PUBLIC and this is tracked source. It holds VERDICTS and synthetic labels — never specimens, never a credential, never the pattern searched for. A capture that cannot be written under the clauses above is not written at all.
